issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method is declared without an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), while the problem UML and the solution define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This structural mismatch can confuse students about the intended private helper signature and prevents straightforward implementation of singFarmSong() which is expected to call singFarmSongVerse(animal).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Farm.java method signature to match the specification and solution: declare private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and adjust the method body accordingly so students can call singFarmSongVerse(animal) from singFarmSong().
